sections.title: Support the Collision Repair Industry
body: With thousands of Gold Class facilities nationwide, I-CAR is positioned to help supporting service organizations stay connected to the needs of modern collision repair.

sections.title: Together, We All Win
body: Explore the benefits the I-CAR Sustaining Partner Program provides, including access to information, course content and marketing opportunities.

sections.title: Training That Matters
body: Getting the right training for individual or business needs is easier than ever.

cards.title: Explore I-CAR Learning
cards.body: Discover the learning catalog across roles and subjects.

cards.title: Industry Training Alliance
cards.body: Access approved training that can count toward I-CAR credit.

sections.title: I-CAR Academy
sections.label: What's New
body: A new program for shops and schools, I-CAR Academy empowers collision repair professionals through comprehensive education to attract, train, and retain talent in our industry.

sections.title: Emerging Technologies
body: Keep up with advanced technology with courses and solutions for ADAS, EV and vehicle-specific repair information.

cards.title: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
cards.body: Understand ADAS-related repair and calibration support.

cards.title: Electric Vehicles
cards.body: Stay current with EV repair and safety topics.

sections.title: Get Started with I-CAR
body: Don't wait, contact us today to unlock the power of training to advance your career in collision repair.
